frozen_model.rule: Live data refreshes may not change model rules, thresholds, weights, hierarchy or pair-construction logic.

required_sequence: validated candidate CERT53 with exactly 28 pairs
GMFQ_CERT53_REFRESH_PROVENANCE_V1 record with unique refresh_id and candidate SHA256
verify CERT53 manifest hash, part mapping and single occurrence
rollback CERT53, runtime part, manifest and provenance record on any post-apply failure
forbidden: CERT53 apply without exact refresh-id confirmation
leaving manifest.v2 stale after CERT53 apply
cert53_canonical_refresh.dry_run_proof: CERT53 Provenance Dry Run V1 passed on 2026-10-07 with no live/runtime/provenance mutation.

pipeline.purpose: Collect only source-approved live updates into a staging branch/worktree. Never write directly to main or gh-pages.
required_outputs: candidate source files or section JSON

pipeline.purpose: Normalize units/frequency/source metadata and apply WITHHELD when data cannot be validated.
Write validated changes first to live_data/sections and regenerate live_data/manifest.v2.json. CERT53 must use the canonical transactional wrapper and provenance record.
pipeline.contract: live_data is the canonical editable data layer; payload is a generated runtime representation, not the primary update target.
required_checks: CERT53 provenance linked when CERT53 changes

pipeline.purpose: Rebuild or surgically update payload from the validated live_data layer using one deterministic path, then regenerate manifest.v2 from the resulting runtime.
hard_fail: manual payload-only patch without live_data origin

pipeline.purpose: Run Engine Logic Audit on the exact staging commit.
Run Staging Browser Audit on the same exact staging commit.
Recompose a minimal clean release candidate from current main with only validated intended changes.
required_checks: same validated runtime blobs where applicable

pipeline.purpose: Fast-forward main non-force only after both gates pass on the exact release commit.
rules: no promotion after partial gate success

pipeline.purpose: Publish only public runtime files that actually changed.
rules: workflow-only changes do not touch gh-pages

scheduling_policy.reason: Do not schedule until the manual end-to-end pipeline has passed repeatedly with deterministic outputs.

oos_boundary.rule: Live refresh may continue during forward OOS only if it does not alter frozen T0, model rules, thresholds, hierarchy, pair construction or anchor methodology.
oos_boundary.checkpoint_artifacts: Never overwritten by the live update pipeline.

rollback.main: Fast-forward/revert only through reviewed Git history; never rewrite validated history casually.
rollback.gh_pages: Republish last known-good public runtime files.
rollback.data: CERT53 wrapper performs local transactional rollback on post-apply failure; repository rollback still uses reviewed Git history. Other sections restore previous validated live_data section set and regenerate runtime; do not hand-edit runtime to mimic rollback.

next_step: Use the canonical CERT53 wrapper on the next real validated CERT53 candidate in manual mode; keep upstream scheduling disabled until repeated real-refresh and release gates pass.
